<script>
(function () {

  /**
   * ========================================================
   * REQUEST DETAILS VALIDATION
   *
   * Both forms (screen 33 Request Details and screen 32
   * Multiple Subtopics) carry:
   *    - sf_Topic__c
   *    - sf_Sub_Topic__c
   * ========================================================
   */

  function getRequestFields() {
    return {
      topic: document.getElementById('sf_Topic__c'),
      subtopic: document.getElementById('sf_Sub_Topic__c')
    };
  }


  /**
   * Determine whether the current node contains
   * one of our forms.
   */
  function hasRequestForm() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    return !!fields.subtopic;
  }


  /**
   * Validate whichever fields exist on the node.
   */
  function requestDetailsAreValid() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    /*
     * No relevant form on this node.
     */
    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return true;
    }

    var subtopicValue =
      String(fields.subtopic.value || '').trim();

    /*
     * Multiple Subtopics form:
     * only Subtopic exists.
     */
    if (!fields.topic) {
      return subtopicValue !== '';
    }

    /*
     * Standard Request Details form:
     * Topic + Subtopic both exist.
     */
    var topicValue =
      String(fields.topic.value || '').trim();

    return (
      topicValue !== '' &&
      subtopicValue !== ''
    );
  }


  /**
   * Create the validation message.
   */
  function ensureValidationMessage() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return null;
    }

    /*
     * Standard Request Details form has a grid.
     */
    var container =
      document.querySelector('.zt-form-grid');

    /*
     * Multiple Subtopics form does not use the grid,
     * so use the Subtopic field wrapper instead.
     */
    if (!container) {
      container =
        fields.subtopic.closest('.zt-form-field');
    }

    if (!container) {
      return null;
    }

    var existing =
      container.querySelector(
        '.zt-request-validation-error'
      );

    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    var error =
      document.createElement('div');

    error.className =
      'zt-request-validation-error';

    error.setAttribute(
      'role',
      'alert'
    );

    error.setAttribute(
      'aria-live',
      'polite'
    );

    /*
     * Different message depending on form type.
     */
    if (fields.topic) {
      error.textContent =
        'Please select both Topic and Subtopic before continuing.';
    } else {
      error.textContent =
        'Please select a Subtopic before continuing.';
    }

    container.appendChild(error);

    return error;
  }


  /**
   * Show validation errors.
   */
  function showValidationErrors() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return;
    }

    var error =
      ensureValidationMessage();

    var subtopicMissing =
      String(
        fields.subtopic.value || ''
      ).trim() === '';

    /*
     * Topic only needs validation if it exists.
     */
    var topicMissing = false;

    if (fields.topic) {
      topicMissing =
        String(
          fields.topic.value || ''
        ).trim() === '';
    }


    if (fields.topic) {
      fields.topic.classList.toggle(
        'zt-required-invalid',
        topicMissing
      );

      fields.topic.setAttribute(
        'aria-invalid',
        topicMissing
          ? 'true'
          : 'false'
      );
    }


    fields.subtopic.classList.toggle(
      'zt-required-invalid',
      subtopicMissing
    );

    fields.subtopic.setAttribute(
      'aria-invalid',
      subtopicMissing
        ? 'true'
        : 'false'
    );


    if (error) {
      error.classList.toggle(
        'is-visible',
        topicMissing || subtopicMissing
      );
    }


    /*
     * Focus first missing field.
     */
    if (
      fields.topic &&
      topicMissing
    ) {
      fields.topic.focus();
    } else if (subtopicMissing) {
      fields.subtopic.focus();
    }
  }


  /**
   * Refresh validation after the user changes
   * one of the dropdowns.
   */
  function refreshValidationState() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return;
    }

    var subtopicMissing =
      String(
        fields.subtopic.value || ''
      ).trim() === '';

    var topicMissing = false;

    if (fields.topic) {
      topicMissing =
        String(
          fields.topic.value || ''
        ).trim() === '';

      fields.topic.classList.toggle(
        'zt-required-invalid',
        topicMissing
      );
    }


    fields.subtopic.classList.toggle(
      'zt-required-invalid',
      subtopicMissing
    );


    var error =
      document.querySelector(
        '.zt-request-validation-error'
      );

    if (error) {
      error.classList.toggle(
        'is-visible',
        topicMissing || subtopicMissing
      );
    }
  }


  /**
   * Bind fields after node render.
   */
  whenEvent(
    'render:finish',
    function () {

      var fields =
        getRequestFields();

      /*
       * Neither supported form is present.
       */
      if (!fields.subtopic) {
        return;
      }


      ensureValidationMessage();


      /**
       * Bind Topic if this is the standard form.
       */
      if (
        fields.topic &&
        !fields.topic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound
      ) {

        fields.topic.addEventListener(
          'change',
          function () {

            assignSessionVar(
              'sf_Topic__c',
              fields.topic.value
            );

            refreshValidationState();
          }
        );

        fields.topic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound =
          'true';
      }


      /**
       * Bind Subtopic for both form types.
       */
      if (
        !fields.subtopic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound
      ) {

        fields.subtopic.addEventListener(
          'change',
          function () {

            assignSessionVar(
              'sf_Sub_Topic__c',
              fields.subtopic.value
            );

            refreshValidationState();
          }
        );

        fields.subtopic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound =
          'true';
      }


      /*
       * Don't show errors immediately when the
       * node first loads.
       */
      if (fields.topic) {
        fields.topic.classList.remove(
          'zt-required-invalid'
        );
      }

      fields.subtopic.classList.remove(
        'zt-required-invalid'
      );
    }
  );


  /**
   * ========================================================
   * NAVIGATION GUARD
   * ========================================================
   */
  document.addEventListener(
    'click',
    function (event) {

      var fields =
        getRequestFields();

      /*
       * No supported form on this node.
       */
      if (!fields.subtopic) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Allow the user to interact with the form itself.
       */
      if (
        event.target.closest(
          '.zt-form-card'
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Only inspect clickable navigation controls.
       */
      var navigationControl =
        event.target.closest(
          'button, a, input[type="button"], input[type="submit"]'
        );

      if (!navigationControl) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Valid form: allow navigation.
       */
      if (requestDetailsAreValid()) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Invalid form: stop navigation.
       */
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();

      showValidationErrors();

    },
    true
  );

})();
</script>

<script>
/* =========================================================
TOPIC -> SUBTOPIC FILTER (screens 32 and 33)

Every subtopic <option> carries data-topic, written by nodes
17 / 26 from the lane's own intent map. Both screens carry a
Topic and a Subtopic select: the subtopic list shows only the
options whose data-topic matches the chosen Topic, and a
subtopic that no longer fits is cleared, so the pair saved on
the Case is always one Salesforce accepts.
========================================================= */
whenEvent('render:finish', function () {
  var topic = document.getElementById('sf_Topic__c');
  var subtopic = document.getElementById('sf_Sub_Topic__c');

  if (!topic || !subtopic || subtopic.dataset.topicFilterBound) return;
  subtopic.dataset.topicFilterBound = 'true';

  // keep every option once, then rebuild the list for the chosen Topic
  var allOptions = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < subtopic.options.length; i++) {
    allOptions.push(subtopic.options[i]);
  }

  function filterSubtopics() {
    var topicValue = topic.value;
    var keepValue = subtopic.value;
    var keepStillFits = false;

    subtopic.innerHTML = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < allOptions.length; i++) {
      var option = allOptions[i];
      var optionTopic = option.getAttribute('data-topic') || '';
      // the placeholder has no topic and always stays
      if (optionTopic === '' || optionTopic === topicValue) {
        subtopic.appendChild(option);
        if (keepValue !== '' && option.value === keepValue) keepStillFits = true;
      }
    }

    subtopic.value = keepStillFits ? keepValue : '';
    if (!keepStillFits && keepValue !== '') {
      assignSessionVar('sf_Sub_Topic__c', '');
    }
  }

  filterSubtopics();
  topic.addEventListener('change', filterSubtopics);
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  /**
   * AI FEEDBACK (screens 30 and 53)
   *
   * The thumbs buttons are the ONLY writer of ai_feedback. They write it into a
   * native hidden-from-view text field of the same name, because native fields
   * always submit with the button the agent clicks and so always reach form data.
   * ai_feedback_comments is a native textarea on the same screen, shown and
   * focused only on thumbs_down. thumbs_up hides it and clears any text in it,
   * so a comment typed before switching to thumbs up never submits.
   */
  function nativeField(name) {
    return document.querySelector(
      'input[name="' + name + '"], textarea[name="' + name + '"]'
    );
  }

  // The wrapper that holds a native field and its label: walk up while the
  // parent holds only this one control, so nothing else on the screen moves.
  function nativeWrapper(name) {
    var field = nativeField(name);
    if (!field) return null;
    var wrapper = field;
    while (
      wrapper.parentElement &&
      wrapper.parentElement.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').length === 1
    ) {
      wrapper = wrapper.parentElement;
    }
    return wrapper;
  }

  function setNativeFieldVisible(name, visible) {
    var wrapper = nativeWrapper(name);
    if (wrapper) wrapper.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
  }

  function recordFeedback(value) {
    var field = nativeField('ai_feedback');
    if (field) {
      field.value = value;
      field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    }
    assignSessionVar('ai_feedback', value);
  }

  var statusText = {
    thumbs_up: '👍 Thanks for the feedback!',
    thumbs_down: '👎 Thanks - please say what was wrong in the AI feedback comments box below.'
  };

  function showComments() {
    setNativeFieldVisible('ai_feedback_comments', true);
    var comments = nativeField('ai_feedback_comments');
    if (comments) {
      comments.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      comments.focus();
    }
  }

  function hideComments() {
    var comments = nativeField('ai_feedback_comments');
    if (comments && comments.value !== '') {
      comments.value = '';
      comments.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    }
    assignSessionVar('ai_feedback_comments', '');
    setNativeFieldVisible('ai_feedback_comments', false);
  }

  whenEvent('render:finish', function () {
    var widgets = document.querySelectorAll('.ai-feedback-wrap');
    if (!widgets.length) return;

    setNativeFieldVisible('ai_feedback', false);
    var ratedDown = nativeField('ai_feedback') && nativeField('ai_feedback').value === 'thumbs_down';
    setNativeFieldVisible('ai_feedback_comments', ratedDown);

    for (var i = 0; i < widgets.length; i++) {
      var widget = widgets[i];
      if (widget.dataset.aiFeedbackBound) continue;
      widget.dataset.aiFeedbackBound = 'true';

      var current = nativeField('ai_feedback');
      if (current && current.value) {
        var preselected = widget.querySelector('.ai-feedback-btn[data-feedback="' + current.value + '"]');
        if (preselected) preselected.classList.add('selected');

        var btn = event.target.closest('.ai-feedback-btn');
        if (!btn) return;
        var value = btn.getAttribute('data-feedback');
        var buttons = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-feedback-btn');
        for (var j = 0; j < buttons.length; j++) buttons[j].classList.remove('selected');
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        recordFeedback(value);

        if (status) status.innerHTML = statusText[value] || '';

        if (value === 'thumbs_down') {
          showComments();
        } else {

        }
      });

<pre># claude.md - Email Automation - Allstar - INT (org 605565 "Brent Thomas - Sandbox")

## Purpose
The single Zingtree workflow on the shared Salesforce case page layout for Corpay UK (Allstar).
Runs the account checks once, reads the queue stamped on the case, and then runs the FAST Admin or
the Homecharge AI journey inside this same tree. Detects intent with an AI Action, drafts a reply

## Conventions and gotchas
- PREREQUISITE: Last_Owner_Queue_Name__c must be in the SELECT list of Connected Object 1263 and
  its _prod twin. Until it is, node 8 reads undefined and every case lands on screen 11. Test Mode
  mocks the field, so the routing logic is testable first.
- The queue -> journey mapping is declared once, in node 8. Do not restate it anywhere else.
- An AI Action node carries exactly one ai_action_id, so the two journeys need their own Detect and
  Generate nodes. That is the only reason the lanes exist; they converge at screen 30.
- The lanes keep their own dashboard scripts (17 / 26) because the two scripts read different
  actions.* aliases. Do not merge them into one script with a dynamic alias lookup.
- Both lanes write email_intent / sentiment / escalate_reason under the same names. Only one lane
  runs per session, so there is one writer per session and no duplicate storage.
- Every Test Mode scenario key starts with test_, and nothing that starts with test_ is an intent
  key. The prefix is also the journey selector: test_hc_ makes node 47 mock an Allstar_Chargepass
  case, test_fast_admin_ a FAST_Admin one (node 47 tests for test_hc_ and defaults to FAST Admin).
  This keeps the 32 scenario keys clear of the real intent keys they used to shadow - the 7
  Homecharge ones (hc_missing_charges, hc_tariff_update, hc_update_charger_details,
  hc_password_reset, hc_compatible_chargers, hc_payment_query, hc_resent_onboarding_email)
  and the 13 FAST Admin ones (active_card_list, order_a_new_card and the rest). Node 8 then resolves queue_route from
  the mocked queue exactly as it does live, so Test Mode exercises the routing decision too.
- THE SEND CONNECTED OBJECT OWNS THE REQUEST BODY (final, 2026-09-23). Zingtree string-escapes
  every merge result in a Connected Object body, so a whole body in one variable can never work:
  a JSON.stringify'd string arrived as {\"inputs\":...}, a bare object as Go map syntax
  (map[inputs:[map[...]]]), and ${... | stringify} as escaped JSON again. The body is a JSON
  template with one merge per value. Scalars sit INSIDE quotes, where the escaping is exactly
  what makes HTML with quotes valid JSON; ccAddresses sits bare. Template for CO 1266 / 187
  (and 203 in PROD, with its own case alias):
    {"inputs":[{"emailAddresses":"${actions.sfdc_int__case_email_ai.records[0].SuppliedEmail}",
    "ccAddresses":${transforms.ccAddresses},"emailSubject":"${transforms.email_subject_json}",
    "emailBody":"${transforms.email_body_json}","sendRichBody":true,"addThreadingTokenToSubject":true,
    "addThreadingTokenToBody":true,"relatedRecordId":"${caseId}","logEmailOnSend":true,
    "senderType":"OrgWideEmailAddress","senderAddress":"${ai_email_from_address}"}]}
  Node 36 stages only transforms.ccAddresses ([] when empty). UNTESTED LIVE WITH A CC: if a
  populated list renders without quotes around the addresses, switch that one input to
  "ccRecipientAddressList":"${cc_address_list}" (comma-delimited string).
- CASE FIELDS NEVER RIDE IN AN API REQUEST. The Zingtree Salesforce marketplace app reads every
  sf_<Field> predefined in the tree's variables in as form data (sf_Id is the caseId) and writes
  any the session sets back to that field on the Case. sf_Topic__c, sf_Sub_Topic__c, sf_Origin,
  sf_Energy_Provider__c and sf_Data_Provider__c update the Case that way; CO 187 carries only the
  email. A new Case field is one predefined sf_ variable, never a template or SOQL change.
  (Closes OPEN ITEM #9.) Corpay UK still has to restore field-level access on both provider
  fields - Alex Godfrey, 2026-09-16, pending Joanna - or the app cannot write them.
- An AI Action node carries its own config, separate from the AI Action it points at:
  config "{\"mode\":\"api\",\"instruction\":\"\"}". mode "api" is the one-shot call that writes to
  actions.<alias> and follows the continuation; any other mode renders an interactive panel and
  waits for the agent, whatever output format the Action is set to. Setting the Action to JSON does
  not change it - it is a property of the node, not of the Action.
- Write config as a JSON STRING, not as an object. Zingtree's own export emits the string form; a
  hand-authored file that used a real object is what made nodes open a conversation after import
  (seen 2026-09-14 on the Homecharge tree's nodes 4 and 13). Diff a suspect tree's config against
  a genuine export before assuming the mode itself is wrong.

  ${transforms.<name>} - NEVER setFormData with a bare ${<name>} merge field. A form-data merge
  field does not reliably render markup: on the Homecharge validation screen (21) the select

  renders - case_review_html, requestFormHtml, multipleSubtopicsFormHtml,
  email_sent_summary_html - is a transform, and only HtmlBody, which is a payload value rather
  than a screen, is form data. The three-tree merge moved all seven of this tree's blocks to
  form data; 2026-09-15 moved them back. The seven pairs: 17/26 -> 30, 17/26 -> 33, 17/26 -> 32,
